note: Two recorded areas. The Tokyo pair are synthetic squares kept for the conformance suite, which queries the JP region centre. The 24 Fukui polygons are real GSI 洪水浸水想定区域（想定最大規模） geometry, captured from the tile endpoint above on 2026-08-30 for a 20 km radius around Fukui Station and generalised to ~165 m for size — the six largest pieces per depth band. Fixture mode still labels everything it serves as SIMULATED; what makes these worth recording is that their shape and depth bands are the real ones.
